scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api,worker -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm --filter boss-web dev" "./.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn apps.api.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload" "./.venv/bin/python -m apps.worker.boss_worker.main"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter boss-web test && ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest apps/api/tests apps/worker/tests
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter boss-web lint && ./.venv/bin/python -m ruff check apps/api apps/worker
